title: Digital green transformation of network infrastructure based on artificial intelligence
summary: China Telecom reports that its AI-powered control and operations platform saves more than 900 million kWh a year and has cut CO₂ emissions by more than 500,000 tons.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: China Telecom describes an AI-powered control and operations platform that manages 5.13 million 4G and 5G sectors, 3,800 equipment rooms and 46,000 servers. In the ITU entry, current to June 2025, it reports more than 900 million kWh in annual energy savings and a cut in CO₂ emissions of more than 500,000 tons. It also reports that deployment and operating costs for the energy system fell by 90%. These are aggregate claims by China Telecom. The entry does not provide the underlying accounting data or isolate the contribution of each technical component. China Telecom set targets of more than 99% base station coverage by 2025 and 1.5 billion kWh in annual savings. It planned to rebuild the platform with large language models from 2025 to 2027. No later source reports whether it met these targets, and the 2026 interim edition of the ITU report does not update this use case.
purpose: Reduce telecom infrastructure energy use and improve operations.
system: Digital green transformation of network infrastructure based on artificial intelligence

The account does not isolate AI’s contribution from the surrounding workflow.
